metadata.plan_definition: Illustrative reference plan: same ISO week historical average by store/department, with a 2% planning uplift. It is not an approved company budget.
metadata.financial_assumption_note: The source has Weekly_Sales but no COGS, payroll or operating expense ledger. Contribution and operating contribution are modelled using editable assumptions, not reported actual profit.
metadata.forecast_band_note: Indicative range derived from the 90th percentile of absolute weekly percentage errors in a recursive time-based backtest. It is not a calibrated probabilistic confidence interval.

metrics.evaluation_note: Last 13 (or available minimum) weeks held out; recursive predictions use only prior actuals/predictions. Holiday rows receive 5x weight for weighted MAE.

Base case.description: Model baseline with measured planning assumptions.

Upside.description: Stronger demand and improved price / mix realisation.

Conservative.description: Softer demand and higher operating cost pressure.

methodology.model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor with store/department/store-type categoricals, calendar, holiday, markdown, regional and lagged sales features.
methodology.backtesting: Last 13 (or available minimum) weeks held out; recursive predictions use only prior actuals/predictions. Holiday rows receive 5x weight for weighted MAE.
methodology.reference_plan: Illustrative reference plan: same ISO week historical average by store/department, with a 2% planning uplift. It is not an approved company budget.
